opportunities.name: End-to-end city weekend trip planning
opportunities.description: For a {city} weekend from {checkin} to {checkout}: look up population on Wikipedia and weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com for {adults}, find {activity_queries} on Viator, find a {cuisine} restaurant on OpenTable for {checkin} and {party_size}, save a summary note, and draft an email to {recipient}.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, notes, mail
steps: Search Wikipedia for {city}, open the city article and read the population
Search timeanddate for {city}, open Weather and read the current temperature
On Booking.com, set destination {city}, dates {checkin}-{checkout} and {adults} adults, search, and open the top hotel to get its name and price
On Viator, search each of {activity_queries} and open the top result to get its title
On OpenTable, search '{city} {cuisine}', set the date to {checkin} and party size {party_size}, click Find a table, and open the top restaurant
In Notes, add '{city} {dates}: pop X, T °C, hotel H €P, activities..., dinner R 19:30'
In Mail, compose to {recipient} with subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a body summarising the plan, then send or discard

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, 2 adults, Thames boat + Tower of London, Indian, 2 people, maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6, 3 adults, Guinness Storehouse + Cliffs of Moher, seafood, 3 people, tom@example.com (interrupted by Hacker News at 761.8)
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17, 2 adults, whisky tasting + Highlands day trip, Scottish, 2 people, priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search for city and dates
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for {destination} from {checkin} to {checkout} with {adults} adults and open the top hotel result.
steps: Click the 'Enter destination' combobox and select all
Type {destination} and pick the matching suggestion
Open the date picker and click {checkin}, then {checkout}
Open the occupancy picker, set adults to {adults}, and click Done
Click Search
Open the top hotel and record its name and price

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, 2 adults -> Club Quarters Hotel London City €445
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, 3 adults -> Ashling Hotel Dublin €453
Paris (abandoned after typing the destination)
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, 2 adults -> The Haymarket Hotel €180

opportunities.name: Viator activity search and open top result
opportunities.description: Search Viator for {activity_query} and open the first activity in the results.
steps: Click the search combobox and select all existing text
Type {activity_query}
Click 'Search for {activity_query}' (or the Search button)
Open the first result card and record its title

instances.values: Thames boat London -> Westminster to Greenwich Sightseeing Thames Cruise
Tower of London London -> Tower of London and Crown Jewels Exhibition Day Ticket
Guinness Storehouse Dublin -> Guinness Storehouse Experience
Cliffs of Moher Dublin -> Dublin to Cliffs of Moher, Wild Atlantic Way and Galway
whisky tasting Edinburgh -> 90min Underground Whisky Tasting
Highlands day trip Edinburgh -> Scottish Highlands, Loch Ness and Glencoe Day Trip

opportunities.name: OpenTable restaurant search by city/cuisine, date and party size
opportunities.description: Search OpenTable for '{city} {cuisine}' on {date} for {party_size} people and open the top restaurant.
steps: Click the location/restaurant/cuisine textbox and select all
Type '{city} {cuisine}'
Open the date selector, click Next month as needed, and pick {date}
Select {party_size} in the party size selector
Click Find a table (or Let's go)
Open the top restaurant's details and note the 19:30 slot

instances.values: London Indian, Nov 13, 2 people -> Benares
Dublin seafood, Dec 4, 3 people -> SOLE Seafood & Grill
Edinburgh Scottish, Jan 15, 2 people -> Evergreen Bar & Kitchen

opportunities.name: Save trip note and draft summary email
opportunities.description: Add a trip-summary note and compose an email to {recipient} with subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a plan body.
steps: In Notes, click 'New note', type the summary line, and press Enter
In Mail, click To and type {recipient}
Type the subject '{city} weekend {dates}'
Type the body 'Hi {name}, plan: hotel {hotel} (€{price}), {activities}, dinner at {restaurant} ({cuisine}) on {date}.'
Click Discard (or Send)

instances.values: London, maya@example.com
Dublin, tom@example.com
Edinburgh, priya@example.com

opportunities.description: Search timeanddate for {city} and open its Weather page to read the current temperature.
steps: Click the site search button and the search textbox
Type {city} and press Enter
In the results, click the Weather link for the correct city
Read the current temperature
